zones.name: Ocean Drive & South Beach
zones.description: Iconic coastal boulevard lined with swaying Florida palm trees, pastel Art Deco hotels, and white sandy beaches.

zones.name: Downtown Vice Skyscraper District
zones.description: High-density glass towers, corporate skyscrapers with rooftop helipads, and tight 90-degree drift intersections.

zones.name: Starfish Luxury Island
zones.description: Exclusive island villa enclave nestled in the bay with luxury mansions, fountains, swimming pools, and exotic hypercars.

zones.name: Vice Port & Chop Shop Docks
zones.description: Cargo container yards, freight docks, heavy cranes, and the underground chop-shop dropoff garage.

zones.name: Biscayne Bay Causeway Bridges
zones.description: Long multi-lane bridge straightaways connecting the islands over the open ocean bay. Prime spot for top-speed testing and police roadblocks.
